title: Upper density theorem: μ⌞A has zero n-density at H^n-a.e. point of U ∖ A (Simon Ch. 1, 3.6; parent step 5)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^N, U ⊆ ℝ^N open with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and A ⊆ ℝ^N a Borel set. Then for H^n-almost every x ∈ U ∖ A the n-dimensional density of μ⌞A at x exists and equals 0, i.e. (μ⌞A)(B̄_ρ(x))/(ω_nρ^n) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U A : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → MeasurableSet A → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)), x ∈ U → x ∉ A → HasDensity n (μ.restrict A) x 0
